data.executive_summary: The Logistic Regression model achieved 82.64% accuracy with consistent precision/recall (0.83) on 46 samples. Predictions align with historical class distributions but show slight overprediction bias (-0.087 mean residual).
data.methodology: Used Logistic Regression for binary classification with 46 samples. Validated via confusion matrix analysis and class distribution comparison. Metrics calculated: accuracy, precision, recall, F1.
data.results_analysis: Model metrics: ACCURACY=0.8264, PRECISION=0.8300, RECALL=0.8200, F1=0.8200. Predictions (mean=0.63, std=0.488) show slight negative bias. Visualizations confirm alignment with historical patterns but reveal consistent overprediction.
data.conclusions: The model performs reliably with strong consistency across metrics but requires monitoring for overprediction bias in production environments.
data.recommendations:
1. Monitor prediction bias in production
2. Consider model calibration if bias impacts business outcomes
3. Validate performance on newer data if available
4. Collect additional samples to improve generalization
